name: TG-Gateway Self-Hosted Telegram Agent Gateway
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Telegram agent communication gateway with HTTP APIs, interactive prompts, signed callbacks, multi-channel routing and Docker deployment; no software-enforced usage quota published.
